title: Met up with my ex in Mall World
content: I’d love to know if anyone else has experienced anything similar to this. I have been frequenting mall world for years now, and sometimes when I do, I run into my ex boyfriend. It feels so real. The first time I saw him we were in a neighborhood by the water. We went into a two story blue house with semi decent vibes (rare for my mall world dreams) and we also went to some off brand dollar tree where he told me he had a girlfriend. The next day he started following me on Instagram and I saw him with his new girlfriend?! What is this mall world place?! I still see him there from time to time. Often by the bridges and in the neighborhood with the blue house by the water. The last time I saw him we were walking on this long road along some sort of bank. It’s where the dollar tree is. We walked to this large outdoor pool with a lot people. There were very bad vibes and a fight in the parking lot. It seems like he is a local? He often rides around on a skateboard. He also took me to this large abandoned building that was somehow connected to a hotel on the beach. I walked through the hotel and eventually security guards escorted me out. Has anyone met up with people that are no longer in their lives in mall world? Something very notable about this ex is that he was constantly sleeping. He loved to sleep. Part of me is starting to believe this is some lower astral plane and that I actually am seeing him there. Would love to hear some similar stories
